description_en: Queries the result of an SQL review
description_zh: 获取SQL审核工单的审核结果
name: GetSQLReviewCheckResultStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket. You can obtain the ticket ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257777.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 工单号，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/257777.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the ID of the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid

CheckResultStatus.description_en: The result of the SQL review

CheckStatusResult.description_en: The result of the SQL status check

CheckNotPass.description_en: The number of SQL statements that failed to pass the review
CheckNotPass.description_zh: 检测不通过的SQL数量，单位：条

CheckPass.description_en: The number of SQL statements that passed the review
CheckPass.description_zh: 检测通过的SQL数量，单位：条

ForceNotPass.description_en: The number of SQL statements that failed to pass the manual review
ForceNotPass.description_zh: 人工不通过的SQL数量，单位：条

ForcePass.description_en: The number of SQL statements that passed the manual review
ForcePass.description_zh: 人工通过的SQL数量，单位：条

New.description_en: The number of SQL statements to be reviewed
New.description_zh: 等待审核的SQL数量，单位：条

Unknown.description_en: The number of abnormal SQL statements
Unknown.description_zh: 解析异常的SQL数量，单位：条

CheckedCount.description_en: The number of SQL statements that were reviewed

SQLReviewResult.description_en: The optimization suggestion for SQL statements

MustImprove.description_en: The number of SQL statements that must be modified
MustImprove.description_zh: 必须改进的SQL数量，单位：条

PotentialIssue.description_en: The number of SQL statements that have potential issues
PotentialIssue.description_zh: 潜在问题的SQL数量，单位：条

SuggestImprove.description_en: The number of SQL statements that can be modified
SuggestImprove.description_zh: 建议改进的SQL数量，单位：条

TableIndexSuggest.description_en: The number of SQL statements that can use indexes
TableIndexSuggest.description_zh: 索引推荐的SQL数量，单位：条

UseDmsDmlUnlock.description_en: The number of SQL statements that can be used for lock-free data changes
UseDmsDmlUnlock.description_zh: 推荐使用无锁数据变更的SQL数量，单位：条

UseDmsToolkit.description_en: The number of SQL statements that can be used for lock-free schema changes
UseDmsToolkit.description_zh: 推荐使用无锁结构变更的SQL数量，单位：条

TotalSQLCount.description_en: The total number of SQL statements

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
